title: ContextRef
description: A reference to knowledge, context, historical decisions, run summaries, or external materials. ContextRef is NOT the Knowledge storage itself — Knowledge is responsible for producing and managing the content that ContextRef points to. Protocol only defines the reference format.

source_type.description: Type of the source. Core types: 'knowledge_entry', 'decision_record', 'run_summary', 'external_document', 'playbook', 'pattern'. Extensible — consumers must handle unknown source types gracefully.

source_id.description: Identifier of the source entity within its source_type domain (e.g., a knowledge entry ID, a decision record number).

uri.description: Absolute URI pointing to the context source. Must be a valid URI (e.g., https://github.com/..., file:///path/to/context, urn:ief:context:...). Plain relative file paths are NOT accepted.

relevance_score.description: Relevance score between 0.0 and 1.0 indicating how relevant this context is to the current task.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this context was retrieved.

summary.description: Optional brief summary of the context content, for quick scanning without resolving the URI.
